coverage_limits: This probe inspected the owner-current retained tree and one seed-selected privacy boundary.
It did not alter or rematerialize the peer prototype.
It checked the sole declared rival only; no universal ambiguity claim is made.

followup.approval_effect: none; four-query support would remain prototype evidence until separately reviewed.
followup.requested_change: Expose demonstration and query counts separately, retain at least four distinct queries per fixed-setting episode, label all queries with the matching Racket, and preserve visible-content-only public identifiers.
followup.why: The current CLI accepts only --seed/--out, public_challenge requires exactly four pairs, and its projection hard-codes pairs[:3] as demonstrations plus pairs[3] as one query. Existing rotation evidence proves each fixture can serve as the sole query, but does not provide four simultaneous query inputs.

support_assessment.count_boundary: follow-up needed: retained evidence is fixed at 3 demonstrations + 1 query, not four queries.
support_assessment.privacy_boundary: pass: selected public JSON contains only three labeled demonstrations and one unlabeled query; hidden setting, seed, Racket, rival data, and query answer remain private.
support_assessment.setting_support: pass: ascending/default and descending each have an exact materialized Racket rule and one fixed-setting episode.
support_assessment.source_boundary: prototype / proposed / unapproved; production generator, canonical rule, approval, and training status remain separate.
